item.title: New Tag Autocomplete Extension for Stable Diffusion AUTOMATIC1111 Web UI
item.description:
New Tag Autocomplete Extension for Stable Diffusion AUTOMATIC1111 Web UI

Tag Autocomplete is an extension for the popular AUTOMATIC1111 web UI for Stable Diffusion that provides suggested tags from image booru boards. It displays autocompletion hints for recognized tags to improve prompt accuracy.

🔍 Overview

The extension displays autocompletion hints for recognized tags from image booru boards such as Danbooru and e621. These tags are primarily used for browsing Anime-style illustrations, but they are relevant to a wide range of Stable Diffusion models.

Feature Description
Danbooru & e621 Tags Top 100k tags by post count as of November 2022
Wildcard Support Works with wildcard files from extensions or scripts
Extra Networks Support for Extra Network previews
UI Modes Dark and Light mode support with specific tag colors

🧩 How it works

Completion is triggered by typing a double underscore (__). The extension searches for wildcard files in every extension folder and the scripts/wildcards folder to support legacy versions. It also supports nested folders for grouped wildcards. Because this was one of the first extensions available, it appears high in the inbuilt extensions list when sorting by “oldest first.”

⚙️ Key details

Users can locate the extension by using CTRL + F to search for text on the extensions page. It is compatible with wildcard files used by the AUTOMATIC1111 wildcards extension and other similar scripts. Completion provides exact tags that match training data for many popular models.

🚀 Availability

Installation is available through three primary methods:

  • Using the inbuilt available extensions list within the web UI.
  • Manual cloning of the extension files from the repository.
  • Downloading pre-packaged versions from the project’s Releases page.

💡 Why it matters

Most custom Stable Diffusion models were trained using booru tag information or merged with models that were. Using exact tags in prompts can improve composition and consistency, even if the model itself is designed for a photorealistic style.

#StableDiffusion #Danbooru #AUTOMATIC1111 #AItools #ImageGeneration

Source: DominikDoom/a1111-sd-webui-tagcomplete

item.title: Sygil.Dev Releases Feature-Rich Stable Diffusion WebUI with Low VRAM Support
item.description:
Sygil.Dev Releases Feature-Rich Stable Diffusion WebUI with Low VRAM Support

Sygil.Dev has released a WebUI that provides an easy way to work with Stable Diffusion directly from a web browser. The application features a clean, widescreen-compatible user interface designed to streamline image generation and editing tasks.

🔍 Overview

The tool offers a complete environment for generating and refining images, featuring a dynamic live preview of generations as they are created and an integrated gallery to show outputs for a prompt. It comes with an automated launcher that activates conda and runs Stable Diffusion with a single command. Users can easily customize their defaults right from the WebUI’s Settings tab.

⚙️ Key details

The WebUI incorporates a wide range of features to optimize performance and give users detailed control over their generations:

  • Resource Management: It is designed to be lighter on VRAM, allowing 512x512 Text2Image and Image2Image tasks to work on 4GB of VRAM with the optimized mode enabled in settings. Users can also select GPU usage from the Settings tab or run additional upscaling models on the CPU to save VRAM.
  • Samplers and Upscalers: It supports a collection of K-Diffusion samplers, including k_euler, k_lms, k_euler_a, k_dpm_2, k_dpm_2_a, k_heun, PLMS, and DDIM. It has access to upscaling models including GFPGAN, realESRGAN, and LSDR.
  • Face and Image Editing: Users can improve faces using the GFPGAN model, either at 100% via a checkbox in every tab or by using a dedicated tab with a strength slider. The Gradio advanced img2img editor supports mask and crop capabilities, including mask painting to re-generate specific parts of an image.
  • Prompt and Seed Control: Features include prompt weighting, negative prompts, and prompt validation with warning messages for overly long prompts. A prompt matrix generates images for every combination of prompts separated by the “|” character. Additionally, users can utilize word seeds instead of seed numbers, sequential seeds for batches, and dynamic prompt entry to change settings based on “–params” in a prompt. Loopback mode automatically feeds the last generated sample back into img2img.
  • Text and Image Extensions: The interface supports training custom embeddings on any photo via Textual Inversion training, running existing custom embeddings via the Concepts Library, and an Image to Text feature powered by the CLIP Interrogator. A Text to Video generation feature is also included as a work-in-progress.

🚀 Availability

Although the older Gradio interface is functional and feature-complete, it is no longer being actively developed by Sygil.Dev and is only receiving bug fixes. However, multiple features are currently in development, including Stable Horde integration, ImgLab, batch inputs, and the Gradio mask editor.

#StableDiffusion #SygilDev #WebUI #GenerativeAI #ComputerVision

Source: Sygil-Dev/sygil-webui

item.title: ComfyUI-Easy-Use Adds Support for Anima and Krea2 Models
item.description:
ComfyUI-Easy-Use Adds Support for Anima and Krea2 Models

ComfyUI-Easy-Use, a custom node integration package for ComfyUI built upon TinyTerraNodes, has added support for Anima and Krea2 diffusion models. The update introduces new nodes and security fixes while enhancing workflow efficiency for various Stable Diffusion model variants.

🧩 How it works

The package integrates and optimizes popular custom nodes to create faster and more convenient workflows, restoring a smooth image production experience similar to traditional Stable Diffusion. Key functional updates include:

  • Anima and Krea2 Support: Enabled via easy diffusionModelLoader and easy XYInputs: DiffusionModel.
  • Loader Requirements: The loader requires an explicit text encoder and VAE selection.
  • Noise Injection: Achieved in latent space using easy latentNoisy or easy preSamplingNoiseIn nodes.
  • Prompt Mode: The loader enables A1111 prompt mode, reproducing images nearly identical to those generated by webui.

⚙️ Key details

Recent additions and fixes to the ComfyUI-Easy-Use package include:

Feature / Update Description
New Nodes Added easy PassOrNone with optional default input and matching types; added easy tableEditor for data editing.
Model Support Supports SD1.x, SD2.x, SDXL, SVD, Zero123, Stable Cascade, Layer Diffuse, InstantID, SD3, Kolors, Flux, Anima, and Krea2.
Security Fixes Fixed style preview path traversal; restricted model downloads to public HTTP(S) addresses; fixed easy saveText to confine outputs to the directory.
Performance Use native VAEDecodeTiled for tiled decode with Qwen Image VAE support.
UI Updates Fixed easy imageChooser inactivity after frontend updates; fixed disabled Alt+1–9 template shortcuts blocking browser shortcuts.

🚀 Availability

Users can install ComfyUI-Easy-Use by cloning the repository into the custom_nodes directory and installing the requirements. For specific integrations like InstantID, the ComfyUI_InstantID package must be present. Layer Diffuse usage may require running pip install -r requirements.txt for dependencies.

#ComfyUI #StableDiffusion #Anima #Krea2 #CustomNodes #AIImageGeneration

Source: yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

item.title: SD Prompt Reader Available as ComfyUI Node and Desktop App
item.description:
SD Prompt Reader Available as ComfyUI Node and Desktop App

A simple standalone viewer for reading prompt from Stable Diffusion generated image outside the webui. The SD Prompt Reader is now available as a ComfyUI node.

🔍 Overview

The SD Prompt Reader provides both GUI and CLI. It allows you to perform the following actions:

  • Simple drag and drop interaction
  • Copy prompt to clipboard
  • Remove prompt from image
  • Export prompt to text file
  • Edit or import prompt to images

Vertical orientation display and sorting by alphabet are also included. Dark and light mode support is provided. For desktop builds from current source, see Building desktop applications. For Windows users, Download executable from GitHub Releases. For macOS users, Download executable from GitHub Releases. You may also install SD Prompt Reader via Homebrew cask. brew install –no-quarantine

🚀 Availability

RuinedFooocus PNG support is available in the development version only (#77). If you are using a tool or format that is not on this list, please help me to support your format by uploading the original file generated by your tool to the issues, thx.

⚙️ Key details

The following Safe Diffusion UIs are supported with specified formats.

Tool Supported Formats
A1111’s webUI PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TXT
Easy Diffusion PNG, JPEG, WEBP
StableSwarmUI PNG, JPEG (prior to 0.5.8-alpha)
Fooocus-MRE PNG, JPEG
ComfyUI PNG
Draw Things PNG
NovelAI (stealth pnginfo) PNG, WEBP
NovelAI (legacy) PNG
InvokeAI PNG (prior to 2.3.5-post.2 and prior to 1.15)
Naifu(4chan) PNG

Multi-format support includes PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and TXT. The ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node is a subproject of this project. It is recommended to embed the Prompt Saver node in the ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node within your workflow to ensure maximum compatibility.

💡 Why It Matters

Check out the ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node for more information on the node update.

🛠 Contribute

For macOS and Linux users, see GitHub Releases for executables. Support from A1111’s webUI in PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and TXT. Support from Easy Diffusion in PNG, JPEG, and WEBP. Support from StableSwarmUI in PNG and JPEG (prior to 0.5.8-alpha). Support from Fooocus-MRE in PNG and JPEG. Support from NovelAI in PNG, WEBP, and PNG only. Support from InvokeAI in PNG only (prior to 2.3.5-post.2 and prior to 1.15). Support from ComfyUI in PNG only. Support from Draw Things in PNG only. Support from Naifu(4chan) in PNG only.

#stable-diffusion #ai-tools #prompt-reader #open-source #generation

Source: receyuki/stable-diffusion-prompt-reader

item.title: BFL Releases FLUX 3, Training Models on Video Signals Together
item.description:
BFL Releases FLUX 3, Training Models on Video Signals Together

Intro

BFL released FLUX 3, training a new image generation model on video signals together to improve temporal consistency and understanding of motion.

🧩 Origins

Stable Diffusion’s release prompted Dustin Podell and others to go fulltime into AI. Podell stuck to human content creation while immersing in AI content creation with Andreas Blattmann and Stability AI’s image generation team. After Stability AI fell apart, Anj Midha helped the core group spin out to BFL, which built the FLUX series.

🔍 FLUX 3’s Approach

BFL’s argument for training FLUX 3 was to combine three signals: a still shows where the ball is, a video shows how it got there, and the sound of impact can tell when it hit something even if the camera missed contact. A key example in the FLUX 3 release is the horse in motion.

⚙️ Video Upscaling

FLUX 3 derives its video upscaler from the same FLUX 3 backbone. Sharpening each frame independently might look terrific, but playing it back can show shimmering as the upscaler makes slightly different decisions per frame. Temporal consistency matters even for higher-resolution files. Andreas Blattmann notes that ordinary 2D video contains evidence about what objects look like from other angles.

🚀 Technical Execution

An autoregressive model can learn from all tokens in a training example at once. On the diffusion side, the team distilled long sampling processes down to a handful of steps. Dustin Podell’s early Kontext experiment showed that a model able to draw a dog wearing a hat seemed to know where hats go. A few hours of training got the model to place a logo on a shirt, which was rough but sufficient for offsite discussion. The team then spent months refining the data and model.

💡 Unexpected Use Case

Users fed FLUX old, degraded family photos to restore them, then shared the pictures with families. Podell hadn’t predicted this use. After discussing identity preservation across edits and frames, he noted it’s a nice example of users noticing when something is done right.

#StableDiffusion #AI #FLUX3 #VideoGeneration #ImageGeneration

Source: Building Visual Intelligence — Andreas Blattmann & Dustin Podell, Black Forest Labs — Latent Space

item.title: Stability Matrix: Multi-Platform Package Manager and Inference UI for Stable Diffusion
item.description:
Stability Matrix: Multi-Platform Package Manager and Inference UI for Stable Diffusion

Stability Matrix is a multi-platform package manager and inference interface designed for Stable Diffusion. It provides one-click installation and updates for various Stable Diffusion Web UI packages and includes a built-in Inference interface.

🧩 How it Works

  • Package Management: Manages plugins and extensions for supported packages, including Automatic1111, Comfy UI, SD Web UI-UX, and SD.Next.
  • Dependency Handling: Easily installs or updates Python dependencies for each package without requiring global installation of Git or Python.
  • Portability: The application is fully portable; users can move Stability Matrix’s Data Directory to a new drive or computer at any time.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Version Channels: The software is available in Latest Stable, Latest Preview, and Latest Dev versions.
  • Inference Interface: A reimagined interface built into Stability Matrix featuring:
    • Powerful auto-completion and syntax highlighting using a formal language grammar.
    • Workspaces that open in tabs and save/load from .smproj project files.
    • Customizable dockable and float panels.
    • Generated images that contain Inference Project, ComfyUI Nodes, and A1111-compatible data.
  • Documentation: Users can refer to the documentation index for installation, package management, model, and Inference guides. Recommended starting points include generating a first image, importing local models, or managing installed packages.

🚀 Availability

The application supports the following operating systems:

  • Windows 10 and 11
  • Linux (AppImage)
  • Arch Linux (AUR)
  • macOS (Apple Silicon)

#StableDiffusion #StabilityMatrix #PackageManagement #ComfyUI #Automatic1111

Source: LykosAI/StabilityMatrix

item.title: Multimodal Generative Framework for Culturally Faithful Ulos Motif Generation
item.description:
Multimodal Generative Framework for Culturally Faithful Ulos Motif Generation

Researchers have proposed a multimodal generative framework designed to enable the controllable and culturally faithful generation of Ulos motifs.

🧩 How it works

The framework integrates two primary models:

  • Stable Diffusion XL v1.0: A Latent Diffusion Model fine-tuned via LoRA.
  • LLaMA 1.5-7B: A Multimodal Large Language Model.

To guide the generation process, the system employs four complementary conditioning mechanisms:

Mechanism Function
Text Governs semantic intent
Image Governs generation aspects
Representation Governs generation aspects
Semantic Map (via ControlNet) Governs spatial layout

⚙️ Key details

An ablation study conducted across three scenarios—shape transformation, colour variation, and high-complexity input—found that conditioning effectiveness is not proportional to the number of mechanisms combined:

  • Text + Image + Semantic Map: Achieved the best FID (270) and CLIP Score (0.65 - 0.70), but the weakest SSIM (0.65).
  • Text + Image + Representation: Offered the best overall balance with a stable SSIM (0.84) and competitive FID (280).
  • All four mechanisms: Yielded the weakest FID (330), suggesting conflicting optimization signals.

💡 Why it matters

Qualitative evaluation showed statistically significant positive acceptance from nine weavers (Wilcoxon, p=0.007) and thirty public participants (p<0.001). Additionally, a web-based prototype supporting image-to-image and text-to-image generation was developed as a digital design tool for cultural heritage preservation.

#GenerativeAI #CulturalHeritage #StableDiffusion #LLaMA

Source: Multimodal Conditioning of Fine-Tuned Stable Diffusion XL for Controllable and Culturally Faithful Ulos Motif Generation
